name: MagicMouse
author: 2strange
description: Apple Magic Mouse that feels like on a Mac: touchpad-style scrolling and live workspace swipe, Apple's pointer curve, touch check against hover, edge and palm rejection, live touch preview, battery in the bar. About 98% of the real Mac feel. 2.0 is one 3 MB Rust binary with no dependencies, at about 1% CPU while scrolling on a 13-year-old MacBook Pro.

barWidget.description: Mouse battery and name in the bar; click for pointer, scroll, gesture and touch settings
